steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to ERPNext at http://127.0.0.1:8100/ as Administrator using the password exactly as the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (the browser fills it when typed). Verify sign-in succeeded and report the page shown.
02-find: Find existing Sales Orders with customer names beginning exactly 'Seed:' and report all such customer names exactly as displayed. Do not modify any Sales Order.
03-create: Create a customer named '{{runid}} Bench Customer', leaving customer group and territory at defaults. Save it and verify the customer record exists with that exact name.

04-create: Create a Sales Order for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with delivery date 2026-12-31 and exactly two item rows: choose the exact linked item 'Bench Widget' with quantity 3 and its default rate, and 'Bench Gadget' with quantity 2 and its default rate. Save the draft. Verify the saved order shows exactly those two linked item rows, quantities, default rates, delivery date, and customer; report the new Sales Order ID from its page address.

05-verify: Correct the existing draft Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer'. Ensure exactly two linked item rows: exact 'Bench Widget' quantity 3 and exact 'Bench Gadget' quantity 2, each at its respective default item rate (Bench Widget 40.00; Bench Gadget 125.00). Keep delivery date 2026-12-31. Save and verify the persisted row labels, quantities, rates, date, customer, and page URL ID.

06-assert: assert: Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} for {{runid}} Bench Customer is saved with delivery date 2026-12-31 and exactly two rows: Bench Widget quantity 3 rate 40.00, and Bench Gadget quantity 2 rate 125.00.

07-verify: Submit Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer', confirm the submission dialog if asked, and verify the persisted document is submitted (not Draft) with the same customer, delivery date 2026-12-31, and exact two item rows Bench Widget quantity 3 rate 40.00 and Bench Gadget quantity 2 rate 125.00. Report status and page URL ID.

08-assert: assert: Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} for {{runid}} Bench Customer is submitted with status To Deliver and Bill, delivery date 2026-12-31, and exactly two rows: Bench Widget quantity 3 rate 40.00, and Bench Gadget quantity 2 rate 125.00.

09-add: Add a timeline comment to submitted Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} whose text includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Save/post it and verify the comment appears in the order timeline, reporting its exact text and the page URL ID.

10-assert: assert: Submitted Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} has a timeline comment with exact text '{{runid}} — timeline comment added by the sitelooper run to verify the comment timeline on {{04-create.url.p2}}.' and its page URL ID is {{04-create.url.p2}}.
